meta.name: hyperframes-studio
meta.description: Use when working with a person on a HyperFrames project in Studio: first, whether their message asks for a change at all (questions, loose ideas and "don't change anything" get an answer and a plan, not an edit); for a new film, the plan, storyboard and build order that the HyperFrames launch films follow; and how the timeline should be laid out so it reads well (one caption track, one element kind per track, every scene a sub-composition) and where captions and key content may sit (safe zones). Don't use for how to perform an individual edit (split, trim, retime, volume, copy, swap): that is `creator-editing-recipes.md` in `/hyperframes-core`.
